recalls.summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 GMC Canyon and Chevrolet Colorado vehicles equipped with a manual passenger seat.  The front passenger seat may have a hook attachment that was not properly welded, allowing it to separate from the inboard track of the seat frame.
